T: The mask passes on. So does the recipe.
D: An ageing Zorro trains a young thief to take his place and avenge his family in old California.
P: Serve the mains when Alejandro and Elena dance at the governor's party.
S: Chorizo slices fried and finished in red wine until sticky, Manchego cut into triangles with quince paste, and olives warmed with orange peel.
the Mexican families of old California
Masa beaten with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with chicken in red chilli, folded and steamed 75 minutes.
the Z he slashes into everything
Flour tortillas filled with Monterey Jack and roasted green chilli, cooked in butter until golden and melted, a Z scored into the top before cutting into wedges.
M: the cattle ranches of old California
Skirt steak marinated 2 hours in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, grilled over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, with rice, black beans and fresh salsa.
Chicken thighs browned skin side down, garlic softened, white wine and tomato added with olives and capers, braised covered at 170C for 40 minutes until tender. Crusty bread.
W: a Spanish dessert for the hacienda
Choux dough piped into 180C oil, fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar, with thick hot chocolate.
K: the dance at the governor's party
Red wine, a splash of brandy, orange juice and sliced orange and apple in a big jug, chilled 2 hours, topped with soda water just before pouring.

s.how: Slice 2 chorizo and fry until crisp, then add a splash of red wine and cook until sticky. Cut Manchego into triangles and top each with a sliver of quince paste. Warm olives with strips of orange peel and serve everything on small plates.

s.note: the Z he slashes into everything
s.how: Fill 4 flour tortillas with grated Monterey Jack and chopped roasted green chilli, then fold in half. Cook in butter over medium heat until golden on both sides and melted inside. Score a sharp Z into the top with a knife and cut into wedges.

m.note: the cattle ranches of old California
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime and orange juice with crushed garlic and cumin. Grill over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thinly against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warm black beans and a fresh tomato salsa.

w.note: a Spanish dessert for the hacienda
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 60g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 2 eggs. Pipe lengths into 180C oil and fry until golden. Roll in cinnamon sugar. Melt 150g dark chocolate into hot milk until thick and serve in small cups for dipping.

d.note: the dance at the governor's party
d.how: Slice 2 oranges and an apple into a big jug. Pour in a bottle of red wine, 60ml brandy and 250ml orange juice. Chill for 2 hours so the fruit soaks it up. Top with cold soda water just before pouring into glasses over ice.
